description:
Demolition of commercial and residential properties, site clearance and redevelopment comprising - 
The construction of a mixed-use development comprising five blocks with 527 residential units (311 private units, 108 shared ownership units and 108 affordable rent units), a multiscreen cinema (Use Class D2) of 5,267sqm (GEA), 9,830sqm (GEA) of retail, restaurant and cafe uses (Use Classes A1, A2, A3, A4 and A5), infrastructure including 513 parking spaces, 686 cycle parking spaces, service areas, public realm incorporating pedestrian/cycle circulation areas with associated hard and soft landscaping and private amenity spaces
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The Development hereby approved, shall be begun no later than the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (see attached schedule) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place on any phase until a Phasing Plan for the development is submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The phasing of the development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved phasing plan, unless an alternative phasing plan is first submitted to the Local Planning Authority with an assessment of any effects of the alterations, including any different impacts on the environment, and that alternative plan and assessment is approved by the Local Planning Authority pursuant to this condition.

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place on any phase until a Construction Management Plan (CMP) covering the entire construction stage has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The CMP shall cover: 
"	a site plan
"	a pre-start record of site conditions on the adjoining public highway to be agreed with the council
"	provision for the parking of vehicles of site operatives and visitors 
"	provision for loading and unloading of plant and materials within the site
"	provision for the storage of plant and materials used in constructing the development 
"	the erection and maintenance of security hoarding including decorative displays and facilities for public viewing, where appropriate 
"	wheel washing facilities at the site exit
"	measures to control the emission of dust and dirt during construction 
"	a scheme for recycling/disposing of waste resulting from demolition and construction works
"	appropriate vehicle routes to and from the site
"	measures to ensure the safety of all user of the public highway especially in the vicinity of the site
"	temporary access arrangements and interim loading bays for High Street units.
"	use of operators committed to best practice, demonstrated by membership of TfL's Freight Operator Recognition Scheme (FORS), or similar.
All construction works shall be managed in accordance with the approved CMP.

Condition : 5 - No development shall take place on any phase until a Construction Travel Plan covering the entire construction stage of the development has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved Construction Travel Plan shall then be implemented throughout the construction phase of the development.

Condition : 6 - No development shall take place on any phase until a surface water drainage scheme for the Site, based on sustainable drainage principles and an assessment of the hydrological and hydrogeological context of the development, has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The detailed drainage design must demonstrate an overall net minimum reduction of 50% of surface water runoff from the entire development site via all discharge routes (overland and sewer network) when compared to the total site surface water runoff in its current brownfield state. Detailed drainage design must demonstrate that the site development does not increase flood risk to others. The detailed design of the sustainable drainage scheme shall:
(i) Provide information about the method employed to delay and control the surface water discharged from the site and the measures taken to prevent pollution of the receiving groundwater and/or surface waters;
(ii) Demonstrate that the Sustainable Drainage Systems hierarchy (as defined by the London Plan Policy 5.13) has been applied and provide clear evidence-based justification where measures are deemed to not be practical or not cost effective;
(iii) Include a timetable for its implementation; and
(iv) Provide a management and maintenance plan for the lifetime of the development which shall include the arrangements for adoption by any public authority or statutory undertaker and any other arrangements to secure the operation of the scheme throughout its lifetime.
All drainage works will require approval of the LBH Building Inspection Department and Thames Water Utilities Ltd (TWUL). The calculated peak discharge rate to the TWUL sewer system is to be confirmed during the detailed design stage and agreed with TWUL.
The approved scheme shall then be fully implemented in accordance with the approved details with the timing/phasing arrangements embodied within the scheme, or within any other period that may subsequently

Condition : 7 - (A)	No development shall take place on any phase until, a BREEAM UK New Construction 2011 pre-assessment report for that phase, demonstrating how each commercial unit over 500sqm will achieve an 'Excellent' rating, is submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
(B)	Within 6 months of commencement of above ground works of each relevant unit, a BREEAM UK New Construction 2011 Interim (Design Stage) Certificate, issued by the Building Research Establishment (BRE), to show that a minimum 'Excellent' rating will be achieved, must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
(C)	Within 6 months of first occupation of the relevant building, a BREEAM UK New Construction 2011 (or such equivalent standard that replaces this) Final (Post-Construction) Certificate, issued by the BRE, demonstrating that an 'Excellent' rating, has been achieved, must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 8 - (A) No development shall take place on any phase until details for that phase have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority demonstrating that:
"	At least three of the key elements of the building envelope (external walls, windows roof, upper floor slabs, internal walls, floor finishes/coverings) are to achieve a rating of A+ to D in the Building Research Establishment (BRE) Green Guide to Specification;
"	At least 50% of timber and timber products are to be sourced from accredited Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) or Programme for the Endorsement of Forestry Certification (PEFC) scheme; and
"	No construction or insulation materials are to be used which will release toxins into the internal and external environment, including those that deplete stratospheric ozone.
(B) The building in that phase shall not be occupied until evidence (e.g. photographs and copies of installation contracts) has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate that the development has been carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 9 - (A) No development shall take place on any phase until a scheme for the storage and collection of recyclable and non-recyclable waste, including a timetable for implementation, for that phase, has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved scheme shall then be carried out in accordance with the approved details and managed as such thereafter.
(B) No phase of the development shall be occupied until evidence (e.g. photographs and copies of installation contracts), demonstrating that the development of that phase has been carried out in accordance with the approved details, has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 10 - No development shall take place on any phase until a Bird Hazard Management Plan in respect of the buildings within that phase has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The submitted plan shall include details of:
"	management of any flat/shallow pitched/green roofs on buildings within the site which may be attractive to nesting, roosting and loafing birds. The management plan shall comply with Advice Note 8 Potential Bird Hazard from Building Design.
 
The Bird Hazard Management Plan shall then be implemented in accordance with the approved details on completion of development of that phase and shall remain in force for the life of the development.

Condition : 11 - No development shall take place on any phase until details of disabled access for the buildings and spaces within that phase, have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The disabled access shall then be installed in accordance with the approved details prior to occupation of development of that phase.

Condition : 12 - The Development shall be carried out in accordance with the Phase One Desk Study Deport (ref. 72451) dated June 2013 by Mayer Environmental and the Environmental and Geotechnical Phase II Assessment (Ref 47072099/LORP0001 Final) dated 9 January 2015 by URS. 
During the course of the development: The Local Planning Authority shall be notified immediately if additional contamination is discovered during the course of the development. A competent person shall assess the additional contamination and shall submit appropriate amendments to the scheme for decontamination in writing to the Local Planning Authority for approval before any work on that aspect of development continues. 
Before the development of any phase is first brought into use: The agreed scheme for decontamination for that phase shall be fully implemented and a written validation (closure) report submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval.

Condition : 13 - No demolition or development shall take place on any phase until an archaeological Stage 1 Written Scheme of Investigation (WSI) has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The programme and methodology of site evaluation for land included within the WSI, including the nomination of a competent person(s) or organisation to undertake the agreed works, must then be carried out in accordance with the approved WSI.
If heritage assets of archaeological interest are identified through the Stage 1 WSI, then no demolition or development shall take place for those parts of the site which have archaeological interest until a Stage 2 WSI is submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The demolition and/or development on land included within the Stage 2 WSI must then be carried out in accordance with the approved Stage 2 WSI, which shall include:
A.	The statement of significance and research objectives, the programme and methodology of site investigation and recording and the nomination of a competent person(s) or organisation to undertake the agreed works.
B.	The programme for post-investigation assessment and subsequent analysis, publication and dissemination and deposition of resulting material.

Condition : 15 - No development shall take place on any phase until details have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority for a scheme of acoustic insulation and any other necessary means of ventilation provided for that phase. The resulting internal noise environment provided for the residential units shall not exceed the 'good' limits contained in BS8233:2014, these being: LAeq, 16hour = 35 dB in living rooms; at night (07:00-23:00) LAeq, 8hour = 30 dB, LAFmax = 45 dB in bedrooms; and at night (07:00-23:00) LAeq,1hour = 45dB in Kitchens, Bathrooms and Utility Rooms. The details for each phase shall be carried out as approved before the dwellings to which they relate are first occupied.

Condition : 16 - No development shall take place on any phase until a scheme is submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, giving details of how the buildings, open spaces and car parking in that phase shall address 'Secured By Design' principles. Each phase of the development shall then be carried out in accordance with the approved details and maintained as such thereafter.

Condition : 17 - No development shall take place on any phase until a scheme for the storage and collection of waste and materials to be recycled in that phase has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved scheme shall then be carried out in accordance with the approved details and maintained as such thereafter.

Condition : 18 - No development shall take place on any phase until a scheme to dispose of foul and surface water for that phase has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The scheme shall then be implemented as approved for the relevant phase and maintained as such thereafter.

Condition : 19 - No development shall take place on any phase until details of the 20% active (32 spaces) and 20% passive (32 spaces) charging point provision within the residents' car park have been submitted to and approved in writing. The approved details shall then be carried out in accordance with the approved details and maintained as such thereafter.

Condition : 20 - No development shall take place on any phase until details of the 10% active (25 spaces) and 10% passive (25 spaces) charging point provision within the public car park have been submitted to and approved in writing. The approved details shall then be carried out in accordance with the approved details and maintained as such thereafter.

Condition : 21 - A. No development shall take place on any phase until a scheme for protecting the proposed residential accommodation within that phase from external noise, taking into consideration the recommendations of the Noise & Vibration Chapter of the Environmental Statement, is submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. Such a scheme shall include details of measures to ensure the residential accommodation meets the relevant standards of BS8233. Any works that form part of such a scheme shall be completed as approved before any part of the development within the relevant phase is first occupied.
B. Prior to any phase of the development being occupied, sound insulation test reports, demonstrating compliance by that phase with the scheme approved under Part A of this condition, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 22 - A. No development shall take place on any phase until a noise survey and assessment, carried out in accordance with BS4142:2014 ('Methods for rating and assessing industrial and commercial sound'), has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, ensuring that no proposed dwellings would be exposed to a BS4142 Rating Level of noise from the Hounslow Delivery Office that exceeds the prevailing Background Sound Level. 
B. Prior to any phase of the development being occupied, validation testing shall be carried out to ensure that the rating level described in Part (A) of this condition is not exceeded at Building C and that internal noise levels with windows closed do not exceed a level of 5dB below the BS4142:2014 criteria adopted in the noise chapter, as a result of the operations at the Hounslow Delivery Office.

Condition : 23 - No development shall take place until further bat specific surveys are undertaken in accordance with the recommendations of the Phase 1 Habitat Survey included within the Ecology section of the Environmental Statement. Such surveys shall be submitted to and approved in writing prior to commencement of any phase of the development. Any recommendations arising from the further survey work shall be implemented prior to occupation of any phase of the development.

Condition : 24 - A). No development shall take place on any phase until full details demonstrating how the approved scheme has been designed, up to RIBA Plan of Work Stage 3 (Developed Design), to allow for the future connection to any neighbouring district heat network have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority
B). No phase of the development shall be occupied until evidence demonstrating that the approved scheme under Part (A) of this condition has been implemented, shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved design details and no alterations shall take place without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 25 - Notwithstanding the details contained in the approved Energy Strategy, no development shall take place on any phase above ground until evidence to demonstrate that the risk of overheating of the dwellings and non-domestic spaces has been minimised has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Dynamic thermal modelling of sample dwellings and non-domestic areas following TM52 and TM49 guidance is recommended. Any additional passive measures to minimise overheating recommended from such modelling shall be implemented prior to occupation of any part of the relevant phase of the development and maintained thereafter.

Condition : 26 - No construction work greater than 5m above ground level on any phase shall commence until a Radar Mitigation Scheme (RMS), including a timetable for its implementation during construction, has been agreed with the Operator & HAL Safeguarding and submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The RMS shall then be implemented in accordance with the approved details and operated as such thereafter.

Condition : 27 - No construction work greater than 5m above ground level on any phase shall commence until a "Crane Operation Plan", produced in consultation with the Operator and HAL Safeguarding, has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Construction at the Site shall then only be carried out in accordance with the approved "Crane Operation Plan".

Condition : 28 - Prior to the occupation of any residential unit in any phase, details of a scheme of mitigation for exposure to poor air quality internally for each unit of that phase to ensure exposure to air pollution does not exceed national air quality objectives, with regard to 'London Council's Air Quality and Planning Guidance', has been submitted and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The mitigation must then be carried out in accordance with the approved details. The development shall not include biomass boilers.

Condition : 29 - Prior to the first occupation/use of the relevant phase of the development, the parking, loading and turning spaces for that phase shall be constructed and made available for use. The parking, loading and turning spaces shall then be retained as such and shall not be used for any other purposes thereafter.

Condition : 30 - Prior to the occupation of any phase of the development, a means of vehicular access for that phase shall be constructed in accordance with the approved plans and made available for use.

Condition : 31 - Prior to the occupation of the residential units in any phase, the residential cycle storage for that phase shall be made available for use in accordance with the provision indicated on the approved plans, with the exception of cycle stores associated with Cores A3, C1 and C2 which shall be redesigned and constructed so as not to accommodate more than 50 stands per store. This storage shall consist of a horizontal storage arrangement to ensure accessibility for all residents. The cycle stores shall then be maintained as such thereafter.

Condition : 32 - Prior to the occupation of the commercial units in any phase, the non-residential cycle storage for that phase shall be made available for use in accordance with the provision indicated on the approved plans. This storage shall consist of a horizontal storage arrangement to ensure accessibility for all staff. The cycle stores shall then be maintained as such thereafter.

Condition : 33 - Prior to the occupation/use of any phase, details of exterior lighting for that phase shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development of each phase shall then be carried out in accordance with the approved details and shall be retained as such thereafter.

Condition : 34 - Prior to the occupation of any phase of the development, evidence (e.g. photographs and copies of installation contracts) to demonstrate that the development of that phase has been carried out in accordance with the approved Energy Statement, and a reduction in CO2 emissions has been achieved in accordance with the London Plan policies, shall be submitted to and approved in writing, by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 35 - Prior to the occupation of any phase, evidence (schedule of fittings and manufacturers' literature), demonstrating that the development of that phase has been constructed to achieve an internal water consumption of the development not exceeding 105 l/p/day in line with The Water Efficiency Calculator for new dwellings issued by the Department of Communities and Local Government, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 36 - Prior to the occupation of any phase, a Delivery and Servicing Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The Delivery and Servicing Plan shall then be implemented as approved and remain in operation thereafter.

Condition : 37 - Prior to the occupation of any commercial unit within any phase, details of shop front and signage specification for that commercial unit shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The shop front and signage specification shall then be implemented as approved and retained as such thereafter.

Condition : 38 - Prior to the occupation of any phase, details of CCTV for that phase of the development shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The CCTV strategy for each phase shall then be carried out in accordance with the approved strategy for each phase prior to occupation of that phase and shall be maintained as such thereafter.

Condition : 39 - Prior to the occupation/use of any ground floor unit of commercial space, full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airbourne and impact sound shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The relevant part of the development shall then be carried out in accordance with the approved scheme and retained as such thereafter. The submission shall include post-completion testing demonstrating that noise levels at the nearest residential receptors will not exceed BS 8233 (good category).

Condition : 40 - No unit within Class A3/A4 use and the cinema (D2 use) shall be occupied/used until a scheme for the control of noise, fumes and odours for that unit, including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant and a detailed assessment of the effectiveness of the scheme, has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The scheme shall then be implemented as approved before the use of the relevant unit commences and shall be retained as such thereafter.

Condition : 42 - Prior to installation, details (appearance and performance specification) of any external ventilation equipment for any phase, including ducting, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The works shall then be carried out in accordance with the approved details before that phase is first occupied. Plant shall be set in from the roof boundaries by a minimum of 2m.

Condition : 43 - Prior to the completion of the frame of a building in a phase, an Ecological Management Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The Plan shall incorporate the recommendations of the Phase 1 Habitat Survey included within the Ecology section of the Environmental Statement and details of how the enhancement measures will be monitored, managed and funded in the future. The development of that phase shall then be carried out in accordance with the approved details and retained thereafter.

Condition : 44 - Prior to the completion of the third phase of the development hereby approved, obstacle lights, each a steady state red light with a minimum intensity of 2000 candelas, shall be placed on the tallest structure (the residential tower). Periods of illumination of obstacle lights, obstacle light locations and obstacle light photometric performance must all be in accordance with the requirements of 'CAP168 Licensing of Aerodromes' (available at www.caa.co.uk/srg/aerodrome). The obstacle lights must be maintained as such thereafter.

Condition : 45 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am to 6pm on Mondays to Friday and 8am to 4pm on Saturdays and not at all on Sundays and Public Holidays.

Condition : 46 - The total floorspace areas of the uses hereby approved shall be in accordance with the approved plans. Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Planning Use Classes Order as amended by the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) (Amendment) (England) Order 2005, (or any Order re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no change of use of the flexible A1-5 floorspace to any other use shall be permitted.
Condition : 47 - No additional floorspace shall be formed within the commercial units hereby approved by means of internal horizontal division.
Condition : 48 - All of the residential units hereby approved shall be designed and constructed to comply with the Lifetime Homes Standard.
Condition : 49 - 10% of the residential units hereby approved shall be designed to be wheelchair accessible, or easily adaptable for wheelchair users.

Condition : 50 - No commercial deliveries shall be taken at or dispatched from the site outside the hours of 07.00 hours to 22.00 hours Monday to Saturday nor outside the hours of 09.00 hours to 14.00 hours on Sundays, Bank or Public Holidays.
Condition : 51 - The use of the A1-A5 uses shall not be open to customers outside the hours of 07.00 hours to 24.00 hours.
Condition : 52 - The cinema shall not be open to customers outside the hours of 06.00 hours to 01.00 hours Sunday-Thursday and 06.00 hours to 02.30 hours Friday and Saturday.
Condition : 53 - No amplified or other music played in or from the Class A3/A4 or D2 uses shall be audible outside of the premises.

Condition : 54 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015 (or any Order revoking and re-enactlng that Order with or without modification), no aerials or satellite dishes shall be erected on any buildings of the development hereby approved.
